label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode and iGPSPORT smart light support.
releaseNotes:
* Dynamic Day/Night Mode UI: Crisp black text in Day Mode (Light Theme) and glowing white text in Night Mode (Dark Theme)
* Magicshine & iGPSPORT 6 Custom Slots: 6 Custom Slots with 0-100% sliders, pattern selection (Steady, Flash, SOS/Breath) & disk persistence
* UI Polish: Intuitive expand/collapse arrow (▼/▲) icon, clean 2-line battery level layout, and high-contrast styling
* iGPSPORT VS1800S dual-beam fallback & ANT+ LightCommandConnectionAIDL fix
